title: Extend router for bar_minute and moneyflow_daily, migrate both full history
instructions: Read .kiro/agents/direct-period-duckdb-migration-loop.md, .kiro/specs/direct-period-duckdb-migration/requirements.md, metadata/dataset-contracts/bar_minute.json, and metadata/dataset-contracts/moneyflow_daily.json first. The router (C:/Workspace/Quanttrading/Quanttrading/server/db/query-entry-router.mjs) already has dataset-parametrized internals (added for bar_daily) -- extend the pattern with two more dataset config entries WITHOUT changing daily_basic or bar_daily's existing exported API/behavior (the current 15 tests must still pass unmodified). Add BAR_MINUTE_CANONICAL_COLUMNS, normalizeBarMinutePointer, classifyBarMinuteTradeDate, buildBarMinuteRouteQuery; and MONEYFLOW_DAILY_CANONICAL_COLUMNS, normalizeMoneyflowDailyPointer, classifyMoneyflowDailyTradeDate, buildMoneyflowDailyRouteQuery. Also add corresponding entries to duckdb-client.mjs's QUERY_ENTRY_DATASETS registry (barMinute, moneyflowDaily keys). Add new unit tests for both mirroring the existing pattern, run the full suite to confirm no regression (15 existing + new ones must all pass). IMPORTANT schema correction: metadata/dataset-contracts/bar_minute.json states logical_key=[ts_code,trade_time], but the live source column is actually named 'ts' (TIMESTAMP), not 'trade_time', and the table mixes two bar frequencies (freq='1m': 2,272,320 rows, freq='30m': 953,562 rows) -- (ts_code, ts) alone has 3,760 duplicate groups; the true uniqueness key is (ts_code, ts, freq). Use this corrected key for all duplicate/consistency checks. bar_minute canonical columns (from live schema, excluding mutable updated_at): ts_code, ts, trade_date, freq, open, high, low, close, volume, amount, source, source_detail, raw_count, quality_status, ingest_run_id. Route/window classification still uses trade_date (the contract's date_column) same as other datasets. moneyflow_daily canonical columns (matches its contract, logical_key (ts_code, trade_date), 0 duplicates found): ts_code, trade_date, buy_lg_amount, sell_lg_amount, buy_elg_amount, sell_elg_amount, net_mf_amount, source, ingest_run_id. Once router/tests are done, migrate BOTH datasets full history in this same task (two source-table reads, two staged Parquet writes, two manifests, two new query-entry pointers) against C:/Workspace/Quanttrading/Quanttrading/data/quant.duckdb, OPEN_READONLY only: bar_minute spans ~2022-01-13 to present (~3.2M rows, use 2022-01-01 as window start), moneyflow_daily spans ~2010-01-04 to present (~8.6M rows, use 2010-01-01 as window start), both windowed through 2027-01-01. For each: inventory, staged Parquet, clean-version-manifest/v1, source-vs-target consistency (row count, date range, the corrected duplicate key check, bidirectional EXCEPT, ordered row checksum using the corrected key columns, null profile, provenance distribution), atomic publish of a NEW per-dataset query-entry pointer, routed smoke (boundary/before/after/invalid/missing plus full-window counts vs source), and freshness smoke for the most recent trade dates. Roll back (delete the new pointer) per-dataset if that dataset's checks fail -- a failure in one dataset does not require rolling back the other if it independently passed. Do not write source DuckDB, drop/archive, or change ingestion. Note transparently in the execution artifact: metadata/dataset-contracts/moneyflow_daily.json states hot_layer.mode='external-only' and migration.candidate_reason='requires pruning proof before default query entry switch' under the data-weight-control spec's separate heuristic -- not a blocker for this explicit human-directed migration. Produce a complete execution JSON+MD artifact covering both datasets, then finish with finish-task using --agent claude so Codex can independently review. Coordination rule: check .ai-coord/tasks for competing tasks before starting; verify any cited codex-review artifact actually exists on disk before treating the review as complete.

human_approval.scope: extend router for two more datasets and migrate bar_minute + moneyflow_daily full history

summary: Rework per Codex r1 changes-requested: fixed dangling provenance.execution_artifact references in both metadata/query-entry/bar_minute.json and metadata/query-entry/moneyflow_daily.json (were pointing to a non-existent two-dataset-<timestamp>.json from a redundant nowStamp() call; corrected to the actual combined artifact bar-minute-moneyflow-daily-20260702t044500z.json via metadata-only atomic write). Re-ran pointer normalization with checkTargetFiles:true and full routed-view smoke for both -- unchanged, still fully transparent (bar_minute and moneyflow_daily routedFull==srcFull, bidirectional EXCEPT 0/0 each). No other fields touched. Resubmitting for review.
